status_note: Rejected at Roc's gate 2026-08-04. Kept on record, not deleted.
learn_source: Watch the farmer bring a late row in ahead of the frost in the Town scene — the harvest has to feed the festival week, and the weather does not wait
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on something near-ripe once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the ripening is even across the whole plant; at baseline it takes fruit by fruit. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: State-dependent: near-ripe fruit finishes ripening within the day; hard green fruit takes no push — too far from ready
Softens past ripe toward spoil — the push has nowhere good left to go
No physical effect — living receivers never catch; nothing about the bird changes

receivers.reaction_kind: wry deflection — points the caster at the row that actually wants it
